source_gaps.description: The standalone machine-readable Continuum v1.2 core implementation artifact referenced by the deep-research report is not present in the repository, conversation files, or Library, and the corpus search is exhaustive: across all four distinct source documents only 3 of the 25 v1.2-named tables carry DDL. The original is treated as unrecoverable. A DERIVED replacement with per-declaration provenance is committed under docs/spec/ (FND-SPEC-001) and is CI-verified against PostgreSQL 18 + pgvector. This gap remains OPEN: issue #2's second close criterion requires the reconstructed detail to be approved through an ADR, which has not happened.
